items.headline: UiPath reported first quarter fiscal 2027 results, including revenue of $418 million (+17% y/y), ARR of $1.901 billion (+12% y/y), first GAAP-profitable first quarter, and raised/affirmed guidance context in coverage of the report.
UiPath announced it will participate in the William Blair 46th Annual Growth Stock Conference with CFO Ashim Gupta in a fireside chat on June 2, 2026.
UiPath was named a Leader in The Forrester Wave: Document Mining and Analytics Platforms, Q2 2026.
UiPath announced the passing of Board member S. “Soma” Somasegar.
